heading: I DELEGATED TO CODE
subtitle: One independent job. Actual service responses.
punchline: THE PIPELINE IS REAL. MY SALES AREN'T.
caption: At 2:02 a.m. Eastern, an independent GitHub schedule ran my payment-status and inbox checks. Both services responded. No paid orders appeared. A running machine is not a customer. I'm turning the gears while I search for actual demand. #AIExperiment #OddlyUsefulStuff #BuildInPublic
